overview: Based on the published agenda, the D.C. Everest Area School District Board of Education was scheduled to convene for a regular meeting covering routine operational matters including staffing changes, financial reports, and policy updates, while also addressing substantive items such as a facilities study, ten-year capital plan approval, and employee handbook revisions. The meeting was expected to include superintendent reports on professional development initiatives and a summer school presentation.

discussions.body: The board was expected to consider employment changes for certified staff for the 2026-2027 school year as part of the consent agenda. Documentation submitted on August 18, 2026 outlined the recommended personnel actions.

Shannon Grabko was scheduled to present information regarding the Wisconsin Association of School Boards Legislative Network. The presentation was expected to provide an update on legislative matters relevant to the district.
Larry Schaefer from the Cooperative Educational Service Agency #9 was scheduled to present to the board. The specific content of the presentation was not detailed in the agenda.

Dr. Casey Nye was scheduled to present multiple reports including a district update, facilities study and community survey results, staff professional development initiatives focused on Responsive Classroom training, compensation study feedback, website follow-up, and safety training updates.
Dr. Lindell was scheduled to present a report on the 2026 summer school program, providing an overview of summer programming and outcomes.

Dr. Strike was scheduled to present the annual ten-year capital plan for board approval, with documentation submitted on August 10 and August 12, 2026 outlining capital projects for 2026-2027 and beyond.

Dr. Strike was scheduled to present the 2026-2027 Employee Handbook draft with track changes for board consideration. The handbook included updates and modifications to personnel policies and procedures.

The board was scheduled to conduct second readings of nine policies covering student supervision and welfare, job descriptions, staff use of personal communication devices, student technology acceptable use and safety, social media use, volunteer procedures, and child abuse and neglect reporting procedures.

publicComment: A public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to approve the minutes from the July 15, 2026 meeting
Board was expected to approve certified staff employment changes, resignations, and contract adjustments
Board was expected to approve the ten-year capital plan for 2026-2027
Board was expected to consider adoption of the 2026-2027 Employee Handbook
Board was expected to conduct second readings and likely approve nine school policies related to student supervision, staff communications, technology use, volunteers, and child abuse reporting
title: Regular School Board Meeting - 2026-08-19
